full_details: In the morning the page took the entrance and not the speech. The loaf was a full thumb short of the same notch, and it was still a penny. Mistress Ansell would not cut another. At two the plot said Fair Em, at the Theatre, and it gave you no name of a part. You did not add one. The tooth was quiet. The letter stayed sealed. At night the moon was up over the close, full enough to find the latch. Phillips was still not told. Tomorrow is rehearsal at nine, and Errors at two.
one_sentence: You let the street go on, played Fair Em, and found the latch.
title: Let the street go on and played Fair Em
